settings.question: Can I add a gift message?
settings.answer: Yes. There's a gift message field at checkout and we write it on a card that goes in the box.

settings.question: Can I send a basket without the alcohol?
settings.answer: Every basket is available booze-free. Look for the booze-free option on the product page, or browse the Booze-Free collection.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: Shipping eligibility is confirmed at checkout. Baskets that include alcohol are limited to eligible states and require an adult 21 or older to receive them.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged or wrong.
settings.answer: Email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and a photo and we'll make it right. All other sales are final.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 3:00pm PT ship the same day. Orders placed after 3:00pm PT, on a weekend, or on a holiday ship the next business day.

settings.heading: Get in touch
settings.intro: Questions about an order, a gift message, or what's inside a basket? Send it over and a real person will get back to you.
settings.hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm PT. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
settings.address: Go-To Gifting, LLC, 2264 Goodyear Ave, STE C, Ventura, CA 93003
settings.aside_note: This address is for mail only, not returns or pickups.
settings.response_time: We reply the same business day.
